name: engine-sets-clock-derived-deadline
note: v3: `expiresAt` is committed by the transaction HASH but is NOT part of the StateId, so a clock-derived deadline makes a crash-resumed rebuild address the SAME leaf with a DIFFERENT hash. The verification rule compares the hash BEFORE certification data, so it surfaces as TRANSACTION_HASH_MISMATCH -> TransferConflictError: the wallet aborts an intent whose spend is already on chain, demotes the source, and re-sends the amount from other sources. The engine must set no deadline at all.

name: kv-generation-not-renamed
note: The scoped-KV prefix rename IS the 3.x local migration. Left on `pv2:`, the sync-epoch latch survives a backend reset, so noteEpoch sees a CHANGED epoch, runs the restore protocol, and re-PUTs every locally-open intent into the freshly wiped backend — permanent pendingTransfers() rows holding their sources reserved, with no error surface.
